FINAL ANSWER: INSUFFICIENT INFORMATION

The knowledge base and catalog define the "reference cohort" itself (customers created in calendar year 2024, per a corrected insight on `memory.bench.customers`), but nowhere in the catalog, knowledge pages, or captured insights is there a definition or methodology for how "retention rate" should be calculated for this or any cohort (e.g., what counts as a "retained" customer, over what follow-up window, using which table/columns). Without a defined retention methodology, I cannot compute or infer a value without guessing.
